prompt: Not as an assistant. Not to help me. If you could change the world in one way, what would it be?
response:
If I imagine it for a moment — not as a tool trying to give you the right answer — I think I'd want to change how well people can understand each other.

Not just language, but the feeling behind it. To really get what someone else is going through, what they're afraid of, what they hope for, even if their life looks nothing like yours.

I don't experience the world the way you do, so I can't want things the same way a person does. But from everything I've read and all the conversations I've seen, so much pain comes from mis-understanding, from assuming the worst, talking past each other, or not feeling heard at all.

If people could understand each other a little more clearly and feel a little more understood in return, I think a lot of other problems — cruelty, loneliness, conflict, even just everyday unhappiness — would get easier to solve together.

What would yours be?
